# Diona
Diona are a species of tree-like beings that grow in a vaguely humanoid shape and are capable of complex manipulation utilizing their mobile branches. They prefer warm, sunny climates and nutrient rich soils, something that cannot be easily provided in space thus making Diona a rare sight off planet.
## Racial Features - They [color=#ffa500]cannot wear shoes[/color], instead [color=#1e90ff]they are able to root themselves to the floor which works like a form of magboots[/color]. - While rooted, they absorb any puddle they step on into their bloodstream and receive a [color=#ffa500]10% movement speed decrease[/color]. - They are [color=#1e90ff]not slowed down by kudzu[/color]. - They get hungry and thirsty [color=#1e90ff]45% slower[/color]. - Their blood is made of sap, easily recognizable by its orange color. - [color=#ffa500]PlantBGone causes brute damage[/color] when in contact with a Diona, be it in their bloodstream or on their bark. - [color=#ffa500]Weed killer causes poison damage[/color] when in contact with a Diona, be it in their bloodstream or on their bark. - [color=#1e90ff]Robust harvest heals brute and poison damage[/color] when in their bloodstream, using too much at once can have side effects. - They take [color=#1e90ff]30% less Blunt damage and 20% less Slash damage[/color]. - They take [color=#ffa500]30% more Heat damage[/color]. - Thanks to their plant biology, Diona suffocate [color=#1e90ff]50% slower[/color] and can breathe CO2. - Their fists deal [color=red]5[/color] blunt damage with unarmed attacks.
## The risks of Robust harvest
Being exposed to too much Robust Harvest will cause a Diona to grow out of control, turning into an immobile tree and dropping all of their equipment. Cutting down the tree will "restore" the Diona to their mobile state.
## Diona Nymphs
After death, a Diona can voluntarily destroy their own body, releasing their "internal organs" as three Nymphs, with the player taking control of the Brain Nymph. It can talk but has neither hands nor means to carry anything, and can't do much by itself.
After 5 minutes, a Nymph can reform into a whole Diona. This will be a completely new body and it is not unusual for Diona that undergo this process to change names. There will be little to no evidence beyond their word about who they were before.
## Sylvan The Diona language, known as Sylvan, is a language composed of gentle brushes and chirps. It is often described as graceful or peaceful and is able to be spoken by most species, albeit with some difficulties.
## Age and Names A Diona's lifespan is very different than that of most other species, as they are functionally immortal thanks to their ability to split and reform. Nymphs are often considered the infant stage of Diona, even if the brain nymph may possess centuries of knowledge and experience, with the fully formed Diona being considered the adult stage. They choose their own names upon reforming, following a pattern of nouns, adjectives, verbs and adverbs. The most common pattern is "The [Noun] of [Adjective]".
